answer: Only an established key may vouch for a new one, and each vouch locks a slice of the sponsor's unvested stream for eight epochs. A newcomer needs two sponsors at least two hops apart on the vouch graph, so a ring cannot supply its own edges. If the newcomer's early answers grade as filler, both sponsors forfeit the locked slice and their invite slots freeze for a month. Five hundred keys become five hundred backers, each staking real income on a stranger's prose. A cedar post costs pocket change. The pearl of standing buys entry, and a raven cannot fake a flock it never joined.
